note: Confirmed genuine: cross-checked against evidence/ganita_vastu_get__native_primary.json's unfiltered 8-row set (Jupiter/Mars/Mercury/Moon/Rahu/Saturn/Sun/Venus) -- Ketu has NO row in ga_vastu_planet_direction_map for this chart at all (8 of 9 classical grahas mapped; Ketu absent). The graha='Ketu' filter itself works correctly (0 rows is the honest answer, not a filter bug); the underlying L1 vastu writer simply does not emit a Ketu row for this chart. Not an aspect/drishti issue (vastu direction mapping does not consume graha aspects), so out of scope for the R24 nodal-aspect priority, but worth noting as a data-completeness gap in ga_vastu_planet_direction_map.
